name: 4Sight Holdings Limited
summary: Operating primarily in South Africa, 4Sight Holdings Limited is a technology provider that delivers comprehensive solutions to a variety of industries through its subsidiary companies. The firm specializes in advanced autonomous and artificial intelligence capabilities, encompassing areas such as machine learning, big data analytics, cloud and business intelligence, digital twin technology, and simulations. Their expertise further extends to information and operational technologies, production scheduling, horizontal and vertical integration, industrial internet of things (IIoT), cloud service provision, robotic process automation (RPA), and augmented and virtual reality (AR/VR) solutions. These cutting-edge offerings cater to diverse client sectors, including telecommunications, mining, manufacturing, energy, chemicals, as well as both private and public organizations. Incorporated in 2017, 4Sight Holdings Limited maintains its headquarters in Floreal, Mauritius.
